cause: Engine._prepare exposes the current proposed plan only. The native sandbox masks the work-item directory, so the original canonical contract is inaccessible after plan_artifact changes. The canonical contract exists on the host.

proposed_correction.behavior: Include both the original configured contract and the current proposed plan in explicit read artifacts, deduplicated, without exposing the whole work-item directory. Preserve existing candidate and plan binding checks.
proposed_correction.verification: Add a regression for reviewer contract visibility after architect proposal; rerun all 110 existing tests plus the new regression; regenerate source freeze after success.
proposed_correction.retry: Resume the accepted FAILED reviewer through the normal owner resume mechanism; retain all original job artifacts.
proposed_correction.authorization_required: Canonical Plan section 10 requires owner approval and Phase 2 rerun for any frozen orchestrator change.

changes_applied: Evidence and implementation log only; no engine correction, builder dispatch, commit or ERP operation.
